interpretation_rules.visible_valid_positive_snapshot: May establish creation of at least one real component; state unknown fields. Separate reliable enumeration and verified intended owner establish an exactly-one snapshot.
interpretation_rules.full_creation_lifetime_pass: Positive-path final acceptance requires fresh attributable creation, reliable actual count on verified intended owner, declared controller/pawn/world transition and liveness evidence, unchanged baseline behavior and verified rollback. It does not require explaining registry discovery or identifying the factory caller. Independent registry/load/cast/readout evidence is required for negative diagnoses; unmeasured mechanisms stay UNKNOWN.
interpretation_rules.negative_zero_interpretation: Requires independently live readout, relevant cooked registry inclusion/visibility, successful load/cast, verified controller selection, complete component enumeration and a bounded observation window

prohibited_substitutions: Editor Python as packaged gameplay runtime
Sole reliance on PrintString or PrintText without verified shipping behavior
Text export edited into an unverified executable asset
New plugin, loader or native injection
Observer log files or UI messages treated as accepted game commands
current_blockers: Supported graph/event/pin and widget-tree authoring route on the installed editor is not established for unattended construction
New assets, actual mod mount, compilation and cooked registry visibility have not been produced or verified
No independent shipping readout/bootstrap proves zero components or teardown when the probe itself does not run
next_action: Resolve supported graph/widget authoring and actual measurement artifacts, or perform a later bounded manual authoring step. Positive-only attempt and full M0 acceptance remain distinct; do not create empty placeholders tonight.
positive_attempt_gate: Actual supported measurement design and artifacts, reviewed manifest, disposable baseline, deployment authorization and rollback are required. Prior successful runtime visibility or initialization is not required; these may be test outcomes.
